title: lagochilus bungei
intro: Lagochilus bungei, commonly known as the "Chinese bugleweed," is a plant species belonging to the family Lamiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antibacterial properties, which may help to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Lagochilus bungei include its ability to act as an immunomodulator, modulating the immune system to fight off infections and diseases. The bioactive constituents of Lagochilus bungei include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
